listings.title: Mount Laurel Online Estate Auction: Fine Art, Leather Furniture & Collectibles
listings.description: All items in this auction are from a smoke-free, pet-free home. The items have been properly stored and well cared for. Welcome to this premier Mount Laurel, NJ online estate auction presented by B&B Estate Sales. This curated auction features the high-quality contents of a beautifully maintained local residence, showcasing an exceptional selection of fine art, premium home furnishings, and highly sought-after collectibles. Bidding is open now and runs through Saturday, October 24th. PICK UP: SUNDAY 10/25/26 10:00 am-2 pm in Mount Laurel, NJ ONLY The highlight of this sale is a stunning collection of limited-edition mixed media paintings on canvas by renowned artist Anna Razumovskaya, including "Pearl Necklace," "Intermission," "Intermission II," and "Flamenco." Complementing these works is a selection of fine home furnishings, featuring a premium dark brown Oskar Huber leather loveseat, a matching pair of burgundy patterned La-Z-Boy wingback recliners, a large Tiffany-style stained glass table lamp, and a professional Bob Ross studio easel complete with palette and canvas. Collectors will find an outstanding assortment of themed collector plates, including authentic Norman Rockwell series, Frank Sinatra musical plates by the Franklin Mint, Mark McGwire Home Run Hero plates, and festive holiday collections by artists Jean Sias, Lloyd Garrison, and Dona Gelsinger. Please review all terms and conditions before bidding. Local pickup is required at the conclusion of the sale, with shipping options available for select smaller items.

listings.description: Building on the momentum of the fall Asia Week New York sales, Freeman's Asian Art department is pleased to present our next auction featuring over 320 lots. Highlights include early Chinese pottery figures and wares, a fine selection of late 19th and 20th-century Chinese porcelain vases from a private Chicago collection, alongside an eclectic array of property from various estates. Offering strong provenance at accessible price points, this sale presents a wonderful opportunity for both new and established collectors to acquire attractive works.

listings.title: Collectors
listings.description: This Collectors Auction moves from jewelry, watches, Native American jewelry, silver, and fountain pens into Asian antiques, historical material, period furniture, bronzes, Persian rugs, and fine art. The opening selection includes gold and silver jewelry including Native American and Southwestern pieces, watches by Jaeger-LeCoultre, Omega, and IWC Schaffhausen, antique silver, and fountain pens by S.T. Dupont, Montblanc, Pilot, and Waterman. Asian offerings include Japanese ceramics, lacquerware, tetsubin, bronze and silver objects, 19th-century samurai armor, and woodblock prints by Hiroshige II and Kiyoshi Saito. Chinese material includes jade and hardstone objects, snuff bottles, furniture, paintings, decorative objects, and a Famille Verte porcelain brush pot. Historical material includes a James Monroe autograph, Theodore Roosevelt autographed book, Armenian manuscript pages, early American newspapers, Civil War items, patent models, and an Imperial Russian kindjal dagger. The sale continues with a Baker Milling Road writing desk, other period furniture, bronze sculpture, and Persian Tabriz, Farahan Sarouk, Kashan, and Bidjar rugs. Fine art concludes the sale with paintings, prints, photography, and works on paper by Walter Emerson Baum, Robert Spencer, Giovanni and Antonio Martino, Bernard Badura, Benton Spruance, Ranulph Bye, Stow Wengenroth, Humbert Howard, Elizabeth Osborne, Christopher G. Willett, Bert Stern, and Colin Campbell Cooper.

listings.title: The Classic Estate Group is at Penny Acres, Wilmington DE
listings.description: The Classic Estate Group is pleased to present an exceptional estate sale in Wilmington, DE, featuring a fine selection of luxury designer handbags, vintage fine timepieces, mid-century furniture, and home decor. Highlighting the luxury accessories are iconic handbags including a classic Chanel black quilted leather double flap bag in its original box, a Chanel 2.55 Reissue tweed flap bag, a Saint Laurent quilted leather shoulder bag, a red Prada Saffiano leather tote, and a Louis Vuitton cream white Epi leather satchel. Timepieces feature vintage ladies' Omega and Gucci wristwatches, alongside a remarkable piece of sports history: a 10k gold-toned 1972 Bulova wristwatch presented to NFL Eagles great Tom Brookshier. In addition to fine luxury goods, the home features a curated array of quality furnishings and decorative arts. Furniture highlights include a mid-century tall wood armoire dresser with ribbed panel accents and a black tubular metal arched headboard. Complementing the space are traditional cut crystal table lamps, a large late-20th-century gold-tone wall mirror with a tinted border, and nautical-themed accent decor. Collection pieces also include vintage gold-encrusted glass dinnerware, ceramic serving platters, and specialty serveware. We accept cash and major credit cards via Square for all purchases. Please review the listed dates and times for event schedule details. We look forward to seeing you at the sale!

listings.title: Moorestown Estate Sale: 1972 Williams Pinball, Vintage Toys, Mid-Century & Retro Finds
listings.description: B&B Estate Sales is pleased to present a wonderful estate sale in Moorestown, New Jersey, featuring an eclectic mix of vintage collectibles, mid-century furniture, and nostalgic retro items. Among the highlights of this sale is a highly sought-after 1972 Williams "Spanish Eyes" pinball machine, boasting vibrant, psychedelic graphics on both the backglass and cabinet. Collectors will also find an array of vintage toys and recreational items, including an Aurora Model Motoring Real Racing slot car set in its original box, a classic Wonder Horse spring rocking horse, a vintage Welsh baby stroller, and retro plastic snowboards from Riva and Sledz. For those looking to furnish or decorate, the home offers a beautiful French Provincial style dining set with a cream-painted finish and gold trim, a set of six mid-century folding chairs with teal vinyl seats, and a classic Windsor-style armchair. Decorative highlights include a stunning Tiffany-style stained glass table lamp with a floral tulip motif, a colorful songbird stained glass window panel, and vintage holiday decor. Audiophiles and media enthusiasts will appreciate the vintage Garrard Synchro-Lab 72B turntable, a selection of classic vinyl records, and quality home audio components from Sony and Samsung. This sale will take place on-site in Moorestown, NJ (08057). We accept all major credit cards, Venmo, as well as cash. Please check back for final dates, times, and parking instructions. We look forward to seeing you there!
